title: eriastrum eremicum subsp. yageri
intro: Eriastrum eremicum subsp. yageri, commonly known as Yager's eriastrum, is a rare and endangered species of flowering plant in the borage family (Boraginaceae), native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Yager's eriastrum are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which may exert antioxidant, antispasmodic, and antihistamine effects. However, further research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of using Yager's eriastrum as a medicinal plant.
